newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-DENIAUD STRIKES AGAIN TO GIVE AUXERRE 1-0 WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DENIAUD STRIKES AGAIN TO GIVE AUXERRE 1-0 WIN.

text.p: Thomas Deniaud scored his third European champions' league goal in two matches on Wednesday to give Auxerre a 1-0 home win over Grasshopper Zurich that helped throw group A wide open.
Diomede headed home from close range a short headed cross from the left by winger Bernard Diomede three minutes before the interval.
Deniaud, a stand-in for injured first-choice striker Lilian Laslandes, scored both goals in the French champions' 2-1 win over Rangers in Glasgow three weeks ago.
It was the first goal conceded by Grasshopper in three champions' league matches and with it they lost the lead in the group to Ajax Amsterdam, who beat Glasgow Rangers 4-1, on goal difference.
Auxerre also have six points but are third on goals.
